formulas.ascii: Per scale (small and large, radii in cells) the TPI plane comes from the summed-area table; global standardization gives z = (TPI - mean)/standardDeviation over all valid cells of that scale (population statistics; z = 0 when the deviation is 0; local uses the window DEV instead). Class c(z): 0 if z <= -standardThreshold, 2 if z >= standardThreshold, else 1. With cs from the small scale and cl from the large one: cs 0 -> 1 + cl (canyon, midslope drainage, upland drainage); cs 1 -> cl 0: U-shaped valley 4, cl 1: plain 5 if Horn slope <= slopeThresholdDegrees else open slope 6, cl 2: upper slope 7; cs 2 -> 8 + cl (local ridge, midslope ridge, mountain top). Cells with an invalid elevation, position or slope get 0.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.

Reduce selected x by operation=sum|min|max|extent (min,max). Missing mask selects all. Min/max/extent ignore nonfinite f32; masked f32 sum also ignores them, unmasked sum does not. Empty/all-invalid min/max/extent and empty sum return 0. Integer sums wrap at 32 bits.
